history_note: J-7 and J-30 curves are reconstructed from public historical market-pricing anchors and interpolated where exact meeting-by-meeting historical odds are not freely available. They are shown as derived historical trajectories, not exact exchange snapshots.

BoJ.calendar_source: Bank of Japan Monetary Policy Meetings

BoC.calendar_source: Bank of Canada fixed announcement dates
BoC.market_source: TMX Montréal Exchange COA/CRA CORRA futures
BoC.method_note: Near meetings use 1M CORRA futures where available. Longer 2027 points are interpolated from the public 3M CORRA futures term structure; starred probabilities are derived estimates, not exact TMX meeting odds.

RBA.method_note: RBA cash rate updated after the 29 Sep 2026 decision. Long-horizon path uses the latest ASX Rate Tracker term structure currently available, aligned to official RBA meeting dates; monthly futures yields are indicative market-implied rates, not exact meeting target probabilities.

RBNZ.market_source: RBNZ / BNZ public OIS market-pricing anchors
RBNZ.method_note: Published market pricing anchors are near 3.0% at end-2026 and around 3.6% by Dec-2027. Intermediate 2027 meeting rates are linear interpolation for dashboard continuity; starred probabilities are derived estimates, not exact OIS odds for each meeting.

meetings.source: Derived from RBNZ-reported year-end market pricing
